title: A maintenance brief includes the boundaries
canonical_state: DoneState project queue in Proof & State GTM vault

source.angle: Specific maintenance objectives and explicit limits make a useful delegation brief.

intent.objective: Collect concrete bounded maintenance use cases
intent.cta: Name one repository task you would delegate with clear boundaries

assistance.disclosure: Product-model framing, not a new canary or release claim.

claim_boundary: No directory approval, general availability for arbitrary repositories, automatic merge, measured time savings or customer outcome is claimed. Historical release-status paragraphs are not used as current distribution evidence.
